Overview.Name: Murala Venkateswara Rao
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Plain curd (1 small bowl ~100 g)
Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) & cucumber salad
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g)  & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Evening_Snack (optional): Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat with onion and peanuts (2 cups)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~90 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~90 g) & fish curry (100 g)
Option 3: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) & vegetable salad

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with eggs, fish, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Keep rice portions moderate to help control blood sugar levels.
Eat meals at consistent times to stabilize energy and reduce overeating.
If cravings start, drink buttermilk or eat a boiled egg before taking more food.
